tasks.title: Decide on always-on voice plugins
tasks.description:
Problem

caveman and i-have-adhd change every chat's voice through hooks. pstack's unslop owns prose.

Decision

Needs Valentin. My pick: turn both off.

Fix

  1. Disable both plugins in Claude settings.

  2. Check one fresh chat replies in plain pstack prose.

Risk

Replies get longer. unslop keeps them clean.

Done when

  • The audit rerun shows none of these items.

  • Proof is on this ticket.
